learningObjective: Separate an observed optimizer generalization gap from the contested claim that a geometrically sharp minimum alone causes poor generalization.
mediumRationale: Deterministic SVG is the smallest medium that places a broad and a narrow loss profile side by side while joining them to one unchanged predictor. Mermaid was rejected because this is coordinate geometry, not flow; semantic HTML would weaken the profile-shape comparison; interaction would imply a quantitative transformation and add no necessary lesson; paper-figure reuse has unclear permission and is unnecessary; and no visual would leave the reparameterization critique abstract. The figure is an original conceptual construction rather than a redraw of a source layout.

pages.insight: Introduces loss-surface slices and optimization directions, providing the immediate geometric context for interpreting a one-dimensional loss profile.
Contrasts vanilla and momentum SGD with per-parameter adaptive methods, including Adam's first- and second-moment update.
Covers RAdam and warmup as responses to early adaptive-rate variance; it does not establish a generalization mechanism.
Presents sharpness-aware minimization as seeking neighborhoods of uniformly low loss, but does not address whether ordinary parameter-space sharpness is invariant.

deckReview.notes: All 214 pages of Basic_ML_CS_concepts were searched from extracted text for Adam, stochastic gradient, generalization, minima, and sharpness. The complete relevant run, pages 44-50, was then inspected: page 44 closes backpropagation, pages 45-48 contain the relevant loss-surface, optimizer, warmup, and SAM material, page 49 is an Optimization divider, and page 50 begins normalization. The deck supplies useful context but no optimizer-generalization comparison or reparameterization caveat, so no deck figure is reused.

sources.title: The Marginal Value of Adaptive Gradient Methods in Machine Learning
sources.usage: Used as primary empirical evidence that adaptive methods can reach low training loss yet generalize worse than momentum SGD in some models and benchmark settings.
sources.license: No text, data, plot, or figure copied. The paper is cited for its empirical conclusion only; figure-reuse permission was not assumed from arXiv availability.

sources.title: Sharp Minima Can Generalize For Deep Nets
sources.usage: Used to verify that rectifier-network symmetries can produce functionally equivalent models with arbitrarily different parameter-space sharpness and unchanged generalization.
sources.license: No text, equation, data, or figure copied. The side-by-side profiles and labels are an original conceptual construction; the paper's figure license was not relied upon.

sources.title: Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization
sources.usage: Used to distinguish classic Adam from AdamW and verify that decoupled weight decay substantially improves Adam's generalization, allowing it to compete with momentum SGD on the paper's image-classification experiments.
sources.license: No source text, results table, code, or figure copied; the optimizer claim is paraphrased with citation and no reuse permission is required.

sources.title: arXiv License Information
sources.usage: Used to check that free access does not itself grant figure-reuse rights and that each submission can carry a different license.
sources.license: The policy was consulted only. Because the individual papers' reusable figure rights were not established, the implementation defaults to original artwork.

sourceReview.notes: The primary sources support three separate claims: a setting-dependent empirical optimizer gap, a non-invariance objection to naive sharpness explanations, and the AdamW decoupling improvement. The implemented curves are explicitly illustrative, encode no measurements, and reproduce no source-specific composition or result.

agentReview.reviewer: GPT-5.6 Sol task 1.1 article visual reviewer
agentReview.summary: Read the full article, searched the full deck and inspected the complete neighboring slide run, then checked primary optimizer and reparameterization papers plus arXiv's licensing guidance. Selected one compact original SVG that teaches why apparent sharpness cannot by itself explain generalization.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG has a programmatic title and detailed description. Both profiles use direct labels, identical minimum markers, and a labeled equality connector, so shape, position, and text carry the argument without color. A 360-unit viewBox, short labels, existing responsive visual primitives, and no fixed CSS width preserve readability at 390 CSS pixels, dark mode, grayscale, and print.
